value: NYMEX Crude Liquidity Program (CL and BZ on Globex), volume-threshold incentives
detail: Third CL-covering incentive program found for 2021-2026. Volume thresholds, no quoting obligation stated. Leader program for MCL and QM.
quote: Crude Oil Futures (“CL”) and Brent Last Day Financial Futures (“BZ”) traded on the CME Globex Platform (“Products”). | Start date is June 1, 2024. End date is January 31, 2025.

value: NYMEX Oil Liquidity Provider Program: covers WTI Houston and WTI Midland (Argus) vs WTI Trade Month futures, not CL outrights
detail: Quoting program on crude differential futures (HTT, WTT); CL outrights not in scope. The 2025-12-02 'Modifications to the NYMEX Oil Liquidity Provider Program' filing was not read; its scope may differ.
quote: WTI Houston (Argus) vs. WTI Trade Month Futures (“HTT”) and WTI Midland (Argus) vs. WTI Trade Month Futures (“WTT”) that are traded on Globex (“Products”).
